in_sanskrit.name: Gandhik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious in battle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gandhik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gandha' meaning fragrance and 'Vik' meaning victory or triumph. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known as Gandhivik or Gandhik, who defeats evil and brings peace and prosperity.
